/obj/item/clothing/accessory/anti_sec_pi.name: subversive pin
/obj/item/clothing/accessory/anti_sec_pi.note: While worn on a uniform, the wearer is permanently flagged wanted: a wanted icon on security HUDs and the maximum threat score (10) from anything that assesses threat, such as secbots and turrets. Hitting another person in a uniform with it pins it on them after a 5 second silent do_after.
/obj/item/clothing/accessory/anti_sec_pi.reason: Marks the wearer as wanted on every scanner, and can be pinned on someone else in 5 quiet seconds. A prank that at worst draws fire from a secbot. Black market only.

/obj/item/clothing/accessory/dogtag/borg.name: Pre-Approved Cyborg Candidate dogtag
/obj/item/clothing/accessory/dogtag/borg.reason: A dogtag that adds a line of text when people examine you. Nothing reads it.

/obj/item/clothing/accessory/pandora_hop.name: Hope
/obj/item/clothing/accessory/pandora_hop.note: While attached to a worn uniform, gives the wearer a permanent +6 mood event that is cleared when the uniform is taken off or the pin removed. Nothing else; the pin itself is fireproof.
/obj/item/clothing/accessory/pandora_hop.reason: A trophy from a boosted pandora. A permanent +6 mood and nothing else. Fine to brag with.
